title: Year 3 end-of-year reasoning paper
subject: Mathematics
source: Written for mathematics/y3 lesson 103 (Printed reasoning paper or portal quiz (secure mode))
intro: Lesson 103. 26 minutes. Underline the numbers, draw a bar model if it helps, check units.

questions.q: (a) a family quiz starts at 4:35 and lasts 40 minutes: end time
(b) how many right angles in a rectangle
(c) 3 boxes of 8 dates and 5 loose dates: total
(d) bar chart: apples 14, pears 9: how many more apples
(e) Sami says 3/4 is smaller than 2/4: is he right? Explain
questions.a: No: 3 parts of 4 is more than 2 parts of 4

questions.q: (f) a 1 m ribbon has 35 cm cut off: how much is left
A rope is 85 cm long. 47 cm is cut off. How long is the piece left?
Aisha has £2.40. She buys a pen for 75p. How much change?
A bag of 24 dates is shared equally between 4 children. How many each?
Circle the bigger fraction: 1/3 or 1/5. Explain.
questions.a: 1/3: the whole is split into fewer, bigger parts

questions.q: A pictogram key: one symbol = 2 books. Ali has 5 symbols. How many books?
